about_the_game:
Song of Maka invites you on a wholesome and beautifully healing journey into the Kingdom of Birds. Play as a newly reborn fledgling, exploring the world through song and flight. Encounter diverse avian friends and discover their stories, collect hidden eggs to hatch new companions, or simply pause to immerse yourself in the breathtaking scenery and melodies of the sky islands...

Kingdom of Birds

The heart of Song of Maka takes place in the Kingdom of Birds, a breathtaking realm composed of floating archipelagos. Journey to diverse islands inhabited by various bird species, each brimming with hidden secrets, chance encounters, and captivating stories. From the birthplace of melodies, the "Windsong Isles," and the nature-worshipping "Forest of Eagles," to the snow-covered, bustling metropolis of "Snow Owl City"—six major regions and dozens of unique characters await your discovery.

Singing and Flying

As a little bird, your primary way of interacting with the world is through the magic of your voice. Different soundwaves resonate with various creatures and elements in the environment, altering them to help you progress on your adventure. Along the way, you will grow and collect new feathers that empower you to fly higher and further. You can even discover the feathers of legendary heroes to unlock unique, powerful abilities!

Discover and Hatch Eggs

Mysterious bird eggs are hidden all across the Kingdom of Birds. Bring these precious eggs back to your sanctuary to hatch them into brand-new fledglings. These new companions will bring life to your home and may even provide unexpected assistance during your exploration.

Relax, Listen, and Enjoy

Song of Maka features over 100 meticulously hand-drawn scenes and a wide variety of beautifully animated birds. We have also composed a soothing, original orchestral soundtrack uniquely tailored to each region of the Kingdom. Whenever you need a break, feel free to simply rest on a floating island, watch the birds fly by, and lose yourself in the stunning vistas and peaceful melodies...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7 920 @ 2.7 GHz, AMD Phenom II 945 @ 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card

short_description: Enter the wholesome Kingdom of Birds in Song of Maka. As a newborn bird, explore beautiful sky islands through song and flight. Uncover charming stories, hatch adorable companions, or simply relax to soothing melodies and breathtaking views.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
